notes.zh: 开场：需要《远古遗物》。非AI帝国清除丛林、毒藻、深坑、流沙、沼泽或冰川类障碍时（on_blocker_cleared），隐藏的 ancrel.4030（events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:4828）以 5/5/95 在神谕、哨兵与无事件之间抽取；神谕全银河一次。1天后出现此事件，可建立遗址或不理会。
notes.en: Opening: needs Ancient Relics. When a non-AI empire clears a jungle, kelp, sinkhole, quicksand, swamp or glacier blocker (on_blocker_cleared), hidden ancrel.4030 (events/ancient_relics_arcsite_events_1.txt:4828) draws Oracle / Sentinels / nothing at 5/5/95; the Oracle happens once per galaxy. This event follows a day later; the site may be created or ignored.

notes.zh: 两个选择：唤醒神谕 → 1天后 4036；或直接拿走1000合金、3500工程学研究与500影响力，故事结束。
notes.en: Two choices: wake the Oracle → 4036 a day later; or take 1000 alloys, 3500 engineering research and 500 influence and end the story.

notes.zh: 领袖招募窗口：前五个回应只显示回复（is_dialog_only）；“解雇”1天后到 4038；“招募”（狂热排外与噬杀蜂群不可用）把神谕作为“知名”官员领袖加入。
notes.en: Leader-recruit window: the first five answers only show replies (is_dialog_only); dismissing leads to 4038 a day later; recruiting (not for fanatic xenophobes or devouring swarms) adds the Oracle as a renowned official.

label.en: Dismiss or finally recruit the Oracle

note.zh: 解雇得到合金、工程学研究与影响力；招募同 4036。
note.en: Dismissal gives alloys, engineering research and influence; recruitment as in 4036.

scope.zh: 整条故事：4030 分派与条件、遗址四阶段、唤醒或拿取资源、招募/解雇对话；中英文正文已读。
scope.en: Whole story: the 4030 dispatcher and its conditions, the four site stages, waking the Oracle or taking resources, the recruit/dismiss dialogue; both languages read.

uncertain: ancrel.4031 has six location-specific texts chosen by a carrier flag set in the hidden dispatcher; the compiled conditions show them as alternatives.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现你的帝国名称。
note.en: In the game, your empire's name appears here.

note.zh: 游戏里这里会出现这颗星球的名称。
note.en: In the game, the name of this planet appears here.
